newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net Upland sales of 53,700 running bales (RB) were 44 percent less than the previous week and 30 percent below the 4-week average. The major increases were for Mexico (13,300 RB), Indonesia (13,100 RB), China (11,300 RB, which included 9,700 in new sales, 6,400 in destination changes and 4,800 in cancellations), and Colombia (7,000 RB).
Sales of 74,100 RB for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for South Korea (52,000 RB) and El Salvador (9,000 RB).

Exports of 113,700 RB were off 23 percent from the previous week and 27 percent from the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 54 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 34 percent; and West European, 12 percent.
